canonical_record_key_equivalence_control.precommitted_equivalence_rule: Two accepted terminal records are duplicate-equivalent only when they bind to the exact pending identity and have the same canonical record_key plus identical normalized record content/fingerprint. Sharing only a terminal outcome, claimant, timestamp class, or superficial metadata is insufficient. A reused canonical record_key with different normalized content is a key-collision contradiction and fails closed rather than being collapsed.
canonical_record_key_equivalence_control.newly_verified_invariant: In the deterministic local model, duplicate normalization is an exact-record equivalence relation, not an outcome-voting shortcut: only same-key plus same-normalized-content copies collapse; distinct same-outcome evidence remains distinct, and canonical-key content collisions fail closed.
